title: geckolib issue #727: The game froze and options.txt was modified

text:
[issue by RainSky233]
Game version: 1.21.1 Neoforge-21.1.169
Mod wersion: 4.7.5.1

When I start the game, it sometimes freezes during the 'Minecraft Progress' phase,such as:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c2f8cd3-e576-4f11-b309-7dc07cf7023b)

but it doesn't crash and there won't be any crash logs.When I started the game again,"options.txt"has been modified, especially the resourcepacks settings and keyboard settings have been reset.I can confirm that is the problem caused by this mod, because the problem no longer occurs after it is disabled.

Because there are no crash logs, there are only client logs.
https://mclo.gs/IHYtA5y

[comment by Tslat (collaborator)]
It's not GeckoLib.

Your modpack is an absolute trainwreck that is dying the moment it starts.

[comment by RainSky233 (none)]
The problem was solved after installing **ModernFix** mod.
Laughing at a person **CANNOT** solve it.
